mapper.select: SELECT fno, name, poster, num FROM (SELECT fno, name, poster, rownum as num FROM (SELECT /*+ INDEX_ASC(project_food_house fh_fno_pk)*/fno, name, poster FROM project_food_house)) WHERE num BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT fno,name,type,phone,address,score,theme,poster,images,time,parking, content FROM project_food_house WHERE fno=#{fno}

SELECT fno,name,poster,num FROM (SELECT fno,name,poster,rownum as num FROM (SELECT /*+ INDEX_ASC(project_food_house fh_fno_pk)*/fno,name,poster FROM project_food_house WHERE address LIKE '%'||#{ss}||'%')) WHERE num BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/20.0) FROM project_food_house WHERE address LIKE '%'||#{ss}||'%'
